verdict: The PA/inclination profile does derive a strict projection/deprojection branch: increasing inclination relative to the inner reference produces a negative multiplicative attenuation with no fitted amplitude. It does not derive the positive added outer-capacity branch, because that would require a velocity-squared load not contained in the PA/i profile.
caveat: Because the inner reference is an average over R<=10 kpc, a few inner rows can have a projection factor slightly above unity. This is retained as a digitization/reference caveat rather than clipped.
next_allowed_action: Either freeze the projection-only attenuation branch as a non-endpoint control, or source-review an independent outer-capacity load for the positive added branch before scoring.
